blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Department of Education (DepEd) and the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) are set to forge a memorandum of agreement formalizing the deployment of village watchmen or barangay tanods in public schools. DepEd Assistant Secretary Roger Masapol said on Monday that village watchmen have been deployed to schools since a June school shooting in Leyte, where three were killed and multiple others were injured when two pistol-wielding students opened fire at San Jose National High School. “There will be a signing between DepEd and DILG by Wednesday this week,” he told lawmakers.
